decisions.reason: As comparable firms and clients shifted from Universal Analytics to GA4, this plugin likely meets current aspiration levels well enough to retain, and its close fit with the firm's web-technology work justifies keeping it.

Because Universal Analytics was already being phased out, this product is very likely to fall clearly below aspiration levels versus market alternatives, so management would reallocate resources rather than carry an obsolete plugin.

A retail system interface plugin is a niche but complementary offering whose performance is uncertain rather than clearly failing, so with some organisational slack the firm would likely keep it for now while monitoring demand.

A shop relaunch SEO support service is closely tied to the consultancy's core business and was given stronger website prominence, suggesting it is meeting or is expected to meet aspiration levels and should remain on the market.
